_readme: QA probe thresholds live here, not scattered in scripts (D-20261116-08 item 1). qa_smoke.py reads this file at import time; unreadable/missing -> the literals in qa_smoke.py are used and the log names the fallback.

ask_settle._readme: resident_qa 8792 /ask answer budget = the server's own declared llm.cpu_lane.timeout_s (read from /health) + margin_s, clamped to [floor_s, cap_s]. Calibration anchor: 2026-11-16 06:1x measured 160 tokens answered in 108.1s on the fallback CPU lane (qwen3.5:27b) while the probe gave up at 40s -> the red was structural.

ask_thin._readme: T247: a 200 + gate + tokens reply that carries no words is a thin answer, not a fault. substance_chars = minimum length of the reply left after removing bracketed stage directions (e.g. '（沉吟片刻）') and whitespace/punctuation, when the reply is also wrapped in a stage direction. Calibration anchor: 2026-11-16 06:2x the same /ask returned 200 + gate + 160 tok with reply '（沉吟片刻）' (6 chars) and still read ASK-OK.
